message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and casts dtypes but performs no schema checks, value-range guards, or assertions on the loaded data structure or content.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local file path (os.path.join('data/', dataset + '_data.csv')) with no remote fetch, checksum verification, or authentication.

No detected label flipping detection: The code casts labels to uint8 and appends a null class name when needed, but there is no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation pipeline reads CSV data, casts types, and applies a sliding window, but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or any other filtering mechanism against poisoned or suspicious samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model files, and no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls are implemented anywhere in the visible code.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous label distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense present in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the visible code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART) or adversarial perturbation methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/validation/test splits are performed, there is no evidence of hashed or signed evaluation data, cryptographic isolation of the test set, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads CSV data and applies sliding windows without any input shape, range, or schema validation before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No post-inference checks on model outputs (e.g., probability bounds, NaN guards, or threshold validation) are visible in the inference path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a sensor-based HAR (Human Activity Recognition) system, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable.
